recipes.purpose: Двухколоночная сетка пустых BackgroundPlateSlot в Body CorporateContent.

appearance.descendants: inherit scene; preserve intrinsic Body/Slot transitions
appearance.pageSurface: page-gray by default; page-white only when requested
appearance.explicitComponentRootModes: only intrinsic source-owned modes; never copy resolvedVariableModes

bindings.status: Construction hints correlated with the accepted mappings; mappings remain authoritative.

preview.hostSurface: white preview frame from owner example

body.children: rows directly; no extra grid wrapper

plate.fill: preserve BackgroundColor binding; resolve in inherited context
plate.padding: preserve observed native 24px baseline for this empty example; not a global padding norm

assembly: Create isolated preview and set its declared scene modes before inserting components.
Import verified published variants; load source text fonts; preserve intrinsic source modes.
Insert CorporateContent with native grid width and HUG height. Resolve Body by typed property reference.
Use transparent horizontal rows, bound to spacing.24. Prefer rows directly in Body when planning a new spec; preserve all nodes of an already frozen spec.
Insert up to two Primary/False BackgroundPlateSlot per row. Bind widths to grid.cols6; preserve empty Slot and native height.
Replace only untouched default Body payload within the fresh owned instance after intended rows are inserted.
Record actual final native IDs after SLOT normalization, preserve the result and leave original references unchanged.
constraints: Apply only when the frozen ScreenSpec matches applicability. Preserve every declared spec ID and node, including an explicit wrapper if present; do not silently reshape a frozen spec.
This recipe applies component contracts and does not replace their rules or authorize new props.
Use the native mappings supplied by the host. Recipe bindings are correlated construction hints; stop for a changed identity instead of guessing.
Use the scene collection keys and actual returned mode IDs, never hardcode variable collection IDs from a reference file.
Preserve source-owned Body Level1/Radius1 and Slot Level2/Radius2 transitions.
Empty plates use Primary/False; never detach or replace library fills.
Design checking remains disabled. Preserve partial results; Ready=false.

recipes.planning: Use horizontal rows directly in the root body slot, two items per row, spacing.24, HUG heights and inherited scene appearance. Preserve count and order; the final incomplete row stays left aligned. No extra vertical grid wrapper is needed.
